# docs/proposals

Proposals and reviews written by the two advisor agents in `.claude/agents/`: `quant-advisor` (what to measure, study or show) and `lead-engineer` (architecture, data model, pipelines, engineering roadmap), in plain language for the owner. These agents write only here (plus their own TODO lists). A proposal is not a decision: the owner picks, then the technical lead writes the spec.

## Files
| File | What it's for |
|---|---|
| `README.md` | What this folder is and how to ask for a proposal |
| `2026-10-05-what-next.md` | Quant advisor: what to measure, study or show next, from the data we hold |
| `2026-10-05-engineering-next.md` | Lead engineer: re-checks `TODO-engineering.md` against the database and code, picks the next two items by value ÷ effort |
| `2026-10-05-review-bank-finservice-spec-quant.md`, `…-engineering.md` | The two advisor reviews of the Nifty Bank / Nifty Financial Services spec (changes folded into that spec) |
| `2026-10-07-money-flow-and-top-volume-next.md` | Quant advisor: ideas for Money flow and Top volume; ideas 1, 2 and 4 became specs 0040 and 0041 |

## Rules here
- Files are `YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>.md`; reviews of a spec are `YYYY-MM-DD-review-<topic>-spec-quant.md` / `-engineering.md`.
- Written only by the two advisor agents; the main session and the technical lead don't edit them. Never code or data.
- A study proposal fixes its pass/fail rules in advance, like a study spec; once the study runs they are frozen.
- When the owner picks an item, it moves to `TODO.md` and the advisor's own list keeps a "→ picked" note.
